original.target_description: Knowledge of social skills (TASSK); Treatment versus Delayed Treatment Control, baseline-to-post-treatment Condition X Time ANOVA, adolescents with ASD.

n.sample_role: Adolescent participants in the two mutually exclusive final treatment/control groups contributing teen self-report and parent-rated outcomes, compared at weeks 1 and 12.
n.exclusions: Three additional participants dropped out before completion: one never started, one left after anxiety in the first session, and one was discontinued for missing more than three sessions (p. 598). Two pilot groups of six were excluded from the present study (p. 600). No additional missingness is reported for these teen/parent outcomes; teacher missingness concerns separate analyses.

replication.target_description: Knowledge of PEERS concepts and friendship skills (TASSK); experimental treatment versus waitlist control, pre-to-post Group X Time interaction, adolescents with ASD.

n.location: PDF p. 6, Figure 1 CONSORT; PDF p. 11, Table 3 group header
n.sample_role: Adolescent participants: experimental n = 29; waitlist control n = 29; analytic parent/adolescent sample.
n.exclusions: Of 71 assessed, 8 excluded (2 did not attend intake; 6 failed IQ criterion); 63 randomized, 5 experimental participants discontinued; 29 per group analyzed. Missing items multiply imputed (<10.34% per scale). QSQ outliers winsorized, not deleted.

notes:
Original F statistic retained as printed; no effect-size conversion. Replication refers to final analyzed sample. Replication effect size is the printed partial eta squared, with the F statistic for the same interaction. Narrative bounds used rather than Table 3 threshold entries.
Completion source review (n_o): Table 4 explicitly labels final treatment and delayed-treatment control groups for the named target outcome. Their mutually exclusive final participant counts establish analytic N; teacher missingness belongs to separate analyses. Three noncompleters and two pilot groups of six are excluded.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed Group X Time F statistic for the named outcome; no metric conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Printed less-than p bound belongs to the same Group X Time F test as the extracted statistic; separate within-group post hoc tests excluded.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly describe this assigned outcome as replicated/improved or not supported; outcome-specific narrative verdict.
